title: Furnace Recipe
description: A smelting/cooking recipe defining input items that can be smelted in furnaces or other cooking stations.

input.description: The input item. Can be a simple identifier or include data value.

tags.description: Tags that specify which smelting stations can use this recipe.

priority.description: The priority of this recipe when multiple recipes match.

unlock.description: Conditions that must be met to unlock this recipe in the recipe book.

identifier.description: The unique identifier for this recipe.
